title: Study of the Glymphatic System in Migraine
official: Discovering the Functional Role of the Glymphatic System in the Genesis of the Migraine Attack
summary: This study aimed to investigate the role of the glymphatic system in the initiation of migraine attacks, using non-invasive magnetic resonance imaging techniques and a validated model of migraine induction by nitroglycerin administration. Secondarily, the relationship between the function of the glymphatic system during nitroglycerin-induced migraine attacks and sleep architecture and plasma levels of migraine-involved neuropeptides will be investigated.
